basis: Defining limb and vertebral malformations; duodenal atresia 80-99%; thymic aplasia 30-79% supports immune involvement.
Defined by renal salt-wasting tubulopathy, hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and sensorineural deafness; weakness and motor delay do not establish separate muscle or nerve damage.
Immune-mediated arthritis and defining urethritis; iritis 30-79% supports ocular damage. Skin/nail disease and oral/colonic inflammation omitted at four-axis cap.
Congenital lens coloboma is an ocular structural defect.
Primary lymphatic vessel dysfunction; chronic skin/subcutaneous tissue injury and fibrosis are common over the course (>30%). Secondary infection risk does not establish immune involvement.
Cerebellar degeneration with ataxia and cognitive impairment; nystagmus is neurologic. Hearing loss and optic atrophy are each below 30%.
Multiple enchondromas and osteochondroma-like bone lesions; supplied HPO reports cranial nerve paralysis at 80-99%, supporting neurologic involvement despite unusual frequency.
Defining skeletal dysplasia and joint dislocations; intellectual disability in 5/7. Neonatal respiratory distress does not establish lasting pulmonary damage; proptosis alone is insufficient.
Defined by cerebellar hypoplasia/ataxia, intellectual disability and bilateral partial aniridia. Small selected reports do not establish common additional organ damage.
Corneal ulceration with perforation directly damages the eye; infectious or immune etiology is not established by this concept.
Multisystem disorder with dystonia/cerebellar atrophy, contractures and cardiomyopathy. Other listed manifestations have insufficient frequency evidence for additional axes.
Collagen VI muscular dystrophy with weakness, muscle degeneration and contractures; progressive restrictive respiratory insufficiency affects most patients over the typical course.
Defined by bronchiectasis and chronic bronchitis; occasional elevated sweat chloride does not establish an additional metabolic disorder.
Benign blood-vessel neoplasm arising within the orbit establishes ocular location and vascular origin.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, documented in 11/11 patients.
Defining cervical vertebral fusion; hearing impairment in 20/24 and renal abnormalities in 16/45 support involvement. Neurologic abnormalities 5/19 are below 30%.
Benign neoplasm of the lip, an oral structure within the gastrointestinal axis.
Inherited abdominal obesity/metabolic syndrome; associated hypertension is separately diagnosed and does not establish direct cardiovascular involvement.
Complex spastic paraplegia with central and peripheral neurologic disease; lower-limb muscle atrophy and structural clubfeet are frequent (30-79%).
Cerebellar hypoplasia with developmental impairment and ataxia; skeletal muscle atrophy in 3/5 and strabismus in 4/5 support muscle and ocular functional involvement.
Primary lung carcinoma with glandular and squamous differentiation; metastatic organ involvement is not established.
Defined by cerebral arterial vasoconstriction; headache alone is not brain damage. Stroke, hemorrhage and other damaging neurologic complications are each below 30%.
Defining gingival fibrosis/overgrowth and dental abnormalities affect oral tissues; facial appearance and eyebrow changes do not establish additional organ damage.
Isolated deficiency of the pituitary hormone prolactin is an endocrine disorder; reproductive manifestations do not add another axis.
Umbrella disease of the eyelid and ocular adnexa, explicitly covered by the ocular axis; no additional organ applies across the group.
